threats.title: Customer Credential Stuffing & Impersonation
threats.description: An external attacker uses compromised password lists to impersonate a Customer actor, gaining access to saved cart items, address details, and payment options.
threats.mitigation: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), lockout policies, and CAPTCHA challenges after repeated failed login attempts.

threats.title: Brute-Force Password Guessing & Abuse
threats.description: Automated bots flood the Authenticate User process with credential pairs to guess valid user credentials and hijack active accounts.
threats.mitigation: Enforce IP rate limiting, implement account lockout rules after 5 failed attempts, and use Argon2id password hashing.

threats.title: PII & Credential Exfiltration at Rest
threats.description: Direct extraction or unauthorized access to the User Accounts DB exposes user password hashes, email addresses, and personal profile information.
threats.mitigation: Implement AES-256 database column encryption, enforce salted Argon2id password hashing, and restrict DB access to internal subnets.

threats.title: Session Cache Poisoning & Hijacking
threats.description: Unauthenticated access to the in-memory Session Store allows attackers to overwrite active session keys and hijack authenticated user sessions.
threats.mitigation: Enable TLS authentication and passwords for Redis/Memcached instances and bind session tokens to client browser fingerprints.

threats.title: Credential Interception in Transit (TB1)
threats.description: Username and password payloads sent across Trust Boundary 1 are intercepted over unencrypted HTTP connections.
threats.mitigation: Mandate TLS 1.3 across all entry endpoints and enforce HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS).

threats.title: User Enumeration via Account Queries
threats.description: Attacker probes the query path to check if targeted email addresses exist in the User Accounts database based on response timing.
threats.mitigation: Standardize query execution time and return generic error messages for all failed lookups.

threats.title: Replay of Hijacked Session Tokens
threats.description: Intercepted session tokens sent between Authenticate User and Session Store are replayed to bypass login.
threats.mitigation: Implement short session lifetimes, single-use nonce checks, and token rotation upon activity.

threats.title: Malicious Payload Injection in Order Data (TB1)
threats.description: Address or cart fields sent across Trust Boundary 1 contain injected XSS or SQL payloads targeting internal fulfillment systems.
threats.mitigation: Validate input using strict server-side allow-lists and sanitize all input string parameters.

threats.title: Tampering with Internal Stock Commands
threats.description: Internal microservice communications modifying stock levels are intercepted and altered to manipulate item availability.
threats.mitigation: Authenticate inter-service calls using signed JWT tokens or mTLS.

threats.title: Unauthorized Direct Inventory Decrement (TB5)
threats.description: Attacker bypasses the Checkout Service to execute stock reduction commands directly against the database across Trust Boundary 5.
threats.mitigation: Enforce database firewalls to restrict write queries strictly to the Update Inventory service identity.

threats.title: Exposure of Customer PII in Order Payload
threats.description: Order summary details passed from Checkout Service to Send Order Confirmation expose sensitive customer information.
threats.mitigation: Minimize payload fields to contain only essential reference IDs instead of raw PII.

threats.title: Outbound Email Payload Interception (TB3)
threats.description: Notification data sent across Trust Boundary 3 to the Email Service Provider is eavesdropped on public network paths.
threats.mitigation: Enforce HTTPS/TLS 1.3 for all outbound REST API webhook calls.

threats.title: Gateway Payment Payload Tampering (TB2)
threats.description: Payment modification requests sent across Trust Boundary 2 to the Payment Gateway are altered in transit to divert funds.
threats.mitigation: Secure connection with TLS 1.3 and cryptographically sign API requests using private API keys.

threats.title: Replay of Payment Gateway Callbacks (TB2)
threats.description: Payment gateway confirmation payloads sent across Trust Boundary 2 are captured and replayed to grant free orders.
threats.mitigation: Require unique idempotency tokens and verify signatures on every webhook callback.

threats.title: Unauthorized Modification of Order Status (TB5)
threats.description: Payment updates passing across Trust Boundary 5 are modified before writing to the Orders DB, falsifying transaction history.
threats.mitigation: Enforce strict DB access control and audit log generation for state modifications.

threats.title: Unauthorized Order History Alteration (TB5)
threats.description: Order read/write requests issued by Admin Order Management across Trust Boundary 5 are manipulated to alter accounting logs.
threats.mitigation: Implement strict mTLS and immutable audit logging for all admin database operations.

threats.title: Spoofed or Manipulated Refund Status Response
threats.description: An attacker intercepts or tampers with the Refund Result payload returning from Process Payment to Admin Order Management. By altering success flags or transaction IDs, an attacker can force a failed refund to display as successful (or vice versa) on administrative dashboards, causing accounting discrepancies and masking unauthorized financial operations.
threats.mitigation: Digitally sign internal service response payloads using HMAC or mutual TLS (mTLS), validate transaction reference tokens, and log all returned status codes to an immutable audit database.

threats.title: Unauthorized Order History Alteration (TB5)
threats.description: Order read/write requests issued by Admin Order Management across Trust Boundary 5 are manipulated to alter accounting logs.
threats.mitigation: Implement strict mTLS and immutable audit logging for all admin database operations.

threats.title: Interception of Administrative Login Tokens (TB1/TB4)
threats.description: Admin auth tokens sent across Trust Boundary 1/4 are intercepted, granting full administrative access to the platform.
threats.mitigation: Mandate TLS 1.3, HSTS, and access restricted to administrative VPN connections.

threats.title: Interception of Internal Profile Data (TB5)
threats.description: Internal network eavesdropping captures password hashes and user metadata returning from the database across Trust Boundary 5.
threats.mitigation: Enforce mTLS for all internal database connection traffic.

threats.title: Price Parameter Manipulation in Transit
threats.description: An attacker intercepts the HTTP request for the order total and modifies the price parameter value before submitting the payload to the server.
threats.mitigation: Never trust client-side prices; re-calculate item totals on the server and use cryptographic signatures (HMAC) for parameter integrity.

threats.title: Checkout Race Condition & Double-Discounting
threats.description: An attacker submits concurrent checkout requests to the Checkout Service, causing a race condition that applies discount codes multiple times or duplicates order fulfillment.
threats.mitigation: Implement atomic database operations, lock cart state during checkout, and enforce unique request idempotency keys.

threats.title: Inventory Stock Count Manipulation
threats.description: Parallel requests to the Update Inventory process cause stock depletion values to become negative or miscalculated, creating stock allocation errors.
threats.mitigation: Utilize atomic SQL queries with row-level locks on product inventory tables.

threats.title: Unencrypted Pricing & Stock Table Alteration
threats.description: Unrestricted internal access to the Product/Inventory DB allows unauthorized modification of product prices, discounts, and available stock levels.
threats.mitigation: Restrict database access permissions using least-privilege DB roles and enable read-only access for non-update application modules.

threats.title: Email Worker Denial of Service (DoS)
threats.description: An attacker generates thousands of rapid dummy order events, overwhelming the Send Order Confirmation process and delaying legitimate customer notification receipts.
threats.mitigation: Decouple confirmation generation into asynchronous message queues (RabbitMQ/SQS) with strict per-user message rates.

threats.title: Email Gateway API Key Hijacking
threats.description: An attacker extracts API keys used to connect to the external Email Service Provider, utilizing the platform to dispatch phishing campaigns under the store's domain.
threats.mitigation: Restrict API key permissions by server IP, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC records, and rotate API keys regularly.

threats.title: Client-Side Payment Verification Bypass
threats.description: An attacker tampers with the payment processing pipeline to simulate a successful payment transaction without charging a valid funding source.
threats.mitigation: Perform all payment confirmation checks server-side using direct API callbacks from the payment processor.

threats.title: Third-Party Payment Gateway Callback Spoofing
threats.description: An attacker spoofs incoming webhook responses from the external Payment Gateway to fake transaction approvals and process unauthorized orders.
threats.mitigation: Validate cryptographic HMAC signatures on all payment webhooks and mandate TLS 1.3 with mutual authentication (mTLS).

threats.title: Unauthorized Administrative Action Execution
threats.description: Broken access controls in the Admin Order Management process allow standard users to execute administrative endpoints such as approving manual refunds.
threats.mitigation: Enforce strict server-side Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) checks on every administrative routing endpoint.

threats.title: Order History Breach & Financial Record Leakage
threats.description: Historical customer purchase data and billing details stored in the Orders DB are exposed during an unauthorized database export or backup leak.
threats.mitigation: Apply AES-256 storage encryption at rest, restrict DB backup access to authorized IAM roles, and enable immutable audit logs.

threats.title: Privilege Abuse via Hijacked Admin Identity
threats.description: An attacker steals administrative session tokens or credentials to access the Admin actor role, issuing unauthorized refunds and modifying store records.
threats.mitigation: Require FIDO2/WebAuthn hardware tokens for Admin accounts, enforce IP whitelisting, and set aggressive session timeouts.
